selection: Stratified selection from executions already in the main campaign, combining pseudo-random sampling with preference for less represented parameter values. Entropy, polarization and domain size were not used for selection.
triplet: Three executions share m, F, q, R, alpha and run_id, one per rewiring rule; their initial networks and stochastic updates are independent.

groups.absorbed: All three executions have no discordant edges at 5 million attempts.
groups.zero_only: No execution has active edges, but at least one has zero-overlap edges.
groups.active: At least one execution has active edges at 5 million attempts.

representativeness: This deliberately selected sample does not estimate outcome frequencies in the full parameter grid.
source_metadata_note: The original expanded selection metadata describes the 37 added triplets (12 absorbed, 12 zero_only, 13 active). The complete 67-triplet sample includes the original 30 triplets and totals 22, 22 and 23.
